races.name: Margaret Long Memorial Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.going: Hurdle: good to soft-good in places; chase: good-good to soft in places (inspection 8am)

verdicts.rp: by Ben Hutton: Bumper winner COCONUT MAN has had wind surgery prior to his first run for Dan Skelton and is taken to make a winning start over hurdles.

races.name: Conference & Banqueting Facilities At Limerick Racecourse Maiden Hurdle

verdicts.rp: by Alan Sweetman: Inexperience seemed to get the better of CON DIS IT on his hurdling debut at Clonmel. He may be good enough in this grade.

races.name: Adare Manor Opportunity Maiden Hurdle

verdicts.rp: by Alan Sweetman: It is probably worth giving another chance to DETROIT MAVERICK , a beaten odds-on favourite when third at Clonmel last month.

races.name: Crown & Thistle Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 1)
races.going: Hurdle: good to soft-good in places; chase: good-good to soft in places (inspection 8am)

verdicts.rp: by Alistair Jones: The 5yo DOUBLY BLESSED is taken to make a winning debut for Dan Skelton. Abbey Farmer is well bred and could be interesting.

races.name: Panoramic Restaurant At Limerick Races Mares Handicap Hurdle

verdicts.rp: by Alan Sweetman: Fourth in a competitive handicap at the Curragh last month, GALILEO SPRINGS has fair prospects of picking up a race of this nature.

races.name: Crown & Thistle Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 2)
races.going: Hurdle: good to soft-good in places; chase: good-good to soft in places (inspection 8am)

verdicts.rp: by Ben Hutton: This looks a good opportunity for TURBOCHARGED , who won a bumper at Haydock in March by 7l, to make a winning start over hurdles.

races.name: Follow Us On Instagram Handicap Hurdle (0-100)

verdicts.rp: by Dave Stephens: THE MONKEY POLE (nap) was first past the post then demoted in a beginners' at Thurles five days ago and he can gain compensation here.

races.name: Settle With Claims Care Consultants Handicap Hurdle
races.going: Hurdle: good to soft-good in places; chase: good-good to soft in places (inspection 8am)

verdicts.rp: by Ben Hutton: The 10yo SHOESHINE BOY has dipped below his last winning mark and the forecast rain on Tuesday is very much in his favour.

races.name: Mr Binman Christmas Racing Festival 26th - 29th December Handicap Hurdle (0-100) (Div 1)

verdicts.rp: by Dave Stephens: The manner of TALAS KERA 's win at Gowran suggested there could be more to come and she is taken to defy a 12lb rise.

races.name: DJ Bell Celebration Handicap Hurdle
races.going: Hurdle: good to soft-good in places; chase: good-good to soft in places (inspection 8am)

verdicts.rp: by Ben Hutton: Useful chaser DOYEN DU BAR (nap) can take advantage of an attractive hurdle mark on his reappearance. Razors Edge is feared most.

races.name: Mr Binman Christmas Racing Festival 26th - 29th December Handicap Hurdle (0-100) (Div 2)

verdicts.rp: by Dave Stephens: Preference is for PORTETTA who was still travelling sweetly when unseating at the fourth last at Wexford last time.

races.name: Home Is Where The Heart Is Handicap Hurdle
races.going: Hurdle: good to soft-good in places; chase: good-good to soft in places (inspection 8am)

verdicts.rp: by Alistair Jones: An open handicap. WALK ON SON ran his best race for a while last time at Hexham where he could easily have finished closer.

races.name: Follow Us On Facebook At Limerick Races Handicap Hurdle (0-100)

verdicts.rp: by Dave Stephens: JOLLY POTTER has shaped promisingly the last twice and this step up in trip may enable him to shed the maiden tag.

races.name: Limerick (Ladies Pro/Am) Flat Race

verdicts.rp: by Alan Sweetman: Judged on his runs at Bellewstown and Galway, MARBLE HILL has a good chance of winning for the very capable Georgie Benson.

races.name: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Handicap

verdicts.rp: by Peter Entwistle: The vote goes to BONNIE'S BOY who comes here on the back of a very good Newcastle second (strong form) and can now double his tally.

races.name: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

verdicts.rp: by Jonathan Doidge: The Wolverhampton win by FAHIDI (nap) was pleasing on the eye. That form has since been bolstered and he can go in again.

races.name: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)

verdicts.rp: by Harry March: Danseuse (second choice) showed promise on her debut at Newcastle but BINTNASEEFA gets the vote on her third start.

races.name: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Handicap

verdicts.rp: by Harry March: Anthropologist has been thriving but MOVING SHADOW is selected to go one better than he did over C&D on his handicap debut.

races.name: All-Weather Championship Is Back Handicap (Div 1)

verdicts.rp: by Harry March: A four-time winner for William Knight, RED HAT EAGLE is interesting on his stable debut and is preferred ahead of Bay Breeze.

races.name: All-Weather Championship Is Back Handicap (Div 2)

verdicts.rp: by Andrew Cooper: A chance is taken on MALDEVIOUS who really shaped as if this trip was worth revisiting when plugging on well over 6f here recently.

races.name: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap

verdicts.rp: by Peter Entwistle: Preference is for INVINCIBLE SPEED who shaped with promise after a layoff when a Kempton fifth and can build on it to bag a fifth AW win.
